messages:
Asha (Docs): FYI I opened a tiny PR to update the Dedicated provisioning page: migrating examples to the new autoscale schema and fixing two bad anchors. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822
Theo (ENG): sweet. Which schema bits changed?
Asha (Docs): old examples used `scalePolicy` object + `tenant_id`. New shape is `scale_policies` (list) and `tenant_label`. Also the JS/TS SDK snippet still shows createDedicatedPool().
Rex (Infra): dropping a compact handbook-friendly autoscale example that we can paste:
Rex (Infra): ```yaml
annotations:
  redwood.com/isolation: "reserved-pool"
scale_policies:
  - name: baseline
    min_replicas: 1
    max_replicas: 5
```
Nora (ML): small content tweak: the "quantization" paragraph references a deprecated model recommendation. Replace with: "Prefer per-workload quant profiles and run a small perf vs quality sweep before wide adoption." One sentence.
Theo (ENG): can we also add a short migration table showing old -> new keys? Something tiny like: `scalePolicy` -> `scale_policies`, `tenant_id` -> `tenant_label`, `createDedicatedPool()` -> `reserveCapacity()`.
Asha (Docs): yes I'm adding a 3-line migration snippet and a one-line callout at the top of the doc. Also adding a tiny changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md.
Rex (Infra): on eviction precedence add a 2-bullet note: "reserved: not preempted by shared; shared/burst: may be preempted under pressure." Keep it short.
Asha (Docs): plan for the PR: 1) fix anchors, 2) replace autoscale YAML with Rex's trimmed snippet, 3) update TS/JS SDK snippet to use `reserveCapacity` and show `{ poolId }` return, 4) add migration callout + mini table, 5) swap quant sentence, 6) add a docs-only CI check for YAML anchors (runs link-check). I'll push later today and ping reviewers.
ci-bot: docs-link-check: passed on branch asha/dedicated-migrate :white_check_mark:
Theo (ENG): thanks all. Keep the handbook example under 30 lines and link to an appendix for the longer recipe. :thumbsup:"
